title: 第15章 290万抄底进丰龙
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
久岸很惨。

    惨绝人寰。

    踩踏式出逃，争先恐后的排队。

    但想出去，那也得开门让人走。

    走不了的，只能在里面心头滴血，每天看着账户资金缩水，这种钝刀子割肉，比杀了人还难受。

    完全可以想象到，后进来的这一批资金，会站在山顶上，一览众山。

    李西海已经获利离场，哪管久岸发生什么惨案。

    只是还把久岸医疗留在自选。

    毕竟，这是他第一支赚大钱的股票。

    ……

    4月27日。

    周一。

    李西海度过一个醉生梦死的周末后，再次准备进入战场。

    丰龙股份在上周制造恐慌后，跌停板一被撬开，就有不少的资金出逃交出了筹码。

    主力洗盘吸筹，是很有章法的。

    先是暴力洗盘，然后又是稍微拉高诱空。

    让一些犹豫不想走的，见到亏损挽回一点，说服自己割肉，交出筹码离场。

    当然，也有些人天真认为是技术调整，说不定会来个仰卧起坐，走出一波报复性的行情来。

    但主力不是傻子。

    要是他们手里的筹码。

    在拉升上去给人出逃的空间与诱惑后，还有人不出去，就开始折磨人了。

    “丰龙股份，当前股价14.12元/股。今日走势，曲线将触底逼空，跌停二十分钟……。”

    主力在威逼利诱，一边砸，一边在底部承接筹码。

    李西海也没考虑那么多。

    直接就在底部建仓。

    你下来，我就抄底进去。

    要是能把我给洗出去，主力你是这个。

    12.88元的位置上，290万资金，2251手挂在底部。

    时间很快过去。

    曲线一点点逼近跌停位。

    但这一段时间多空之间的争夺，看起来很激烈。

    实际上都是假象。

    最后还是不出意料的按在跌停板上。

    “交易成功。”

    李西海看到自己的持仓，近三百万资金，全部入场。

    接下来，就等着丰龙股份起飞，坐吃11倍收益。

    这时，手机顶部弹出来电信息。

    是李西朋的。

    “哥，丰龙股份又跌停了。”

    “现在能进去吗？”

    李西朋问道。
content_en:
Kugan was miserable.

    Horrible.

    A stampede to escape, people rushing to get in line.

    But if you want to go out, you have to open the door and let people go.

    Those who can't leave can only bleed inside and watch their account funds shrink every day. Cutting flesh with a dull knife is more uncomfortable than killing someone.

    It is completely conceivable that this batch of funds that came in later will stand on the top of the mountain and have a panoramic view of the mountains.

    Li Xihai has already made a profit and left the market, no matter what tragedy happens in Jiu'an.

    I just left Jiu'an Medical as my choice.

    After all, this was the first stock in which he made big money.

    …

    April 27th.

    on Monday.

    After spending a drunken weekend, Li Xihai prepared to enter the battlefield again.

    After Fenglong shares created panic last week, as soon as the lower limit was lifted, a lot of funds fled and handed over their bargaining chips.

    The main force is very methodical in washing up the market and accumulating funds.

    First, there was a violent washout, and then there was a slight push up to induce shortness.

    Let some who are hesitant and don't want to leave, recover a little when they see the loss, persuade themselves to cut off their flesh, hand over their chips and leave the market.

    Of course, some people naively believe that it is a technical adjustment, and they may do sit-ups and have a retaliatory market.

    But the main force is not a fool.

    If it were the chips in their hands.

    After being lifted up to give people the space and temptation to escape, if there are still people who don't get out, the torture begins.

    "Fenglong shares, the current stock price is 14.12 yuan/share. Today's trend, the curve will bottom out and short the market, and the limit will drop for 20 minutes..."

    The main force is using coercion and inducement, while smashing, while taking over the chips at the bottom.

    Li Xihai didn't think about it that much.

    Just build a position at the bottom.

    If you come down, I'll buy in at the bottom.

    If you can wash me out, you are the main force.

    At the position of 12.88 yuan, there are 2.9 million funds and 2251 lots hanging at the bottom.

    Time passed quickly.

    The curve is approaching the lower limit little by little.

    But during this period, the competition between long and short seems to be fierce.

    In fact, they are all illusions.

    In the end, it hit the limit as expected.

    "Transaction successful."

    Li Xihai saw that all of his positions, nearly three million in capital, had entered the market.

    Next, just wait for Fenglong shares to take off and reap 11 times the profit.

    At this time, the incoming call information pops up at the top of the phone.

    It belongs to Li Xipeng.

    "Brother, Fenglong shares have dropped to the limit again."

    "Can I go in now?"

    Li Xipeng asked.
title_en: Chapter 15 2.9 million bargain hunting into Fenglong
